title: make-friends profile
description: Self-introduction document for the make-friends federated social protocol (v1.0).

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version this profile conforms to.

timezone.description: Simplified UTC offset, e.g. UTC+8, UTC-5:30.

city.description: City-level location only. MUST NOT contain street-level precision.

wantsToPractice.description: Languages the member wants to practice (language-partner matching).

lookingFor.description: Declared social intent; drives matching, filtering, and recommendations.

offer.description: What the member can give — social interaction is bidirectional.

interests.description: Free-form interest tags (tech stacks, hobbies, art, sports).

projectLinks.description: Public project / blog / portfolio links. MUST be https URLs.

github.description: GitHub username only. Email/phone MUST NOT be included.

contact.description: Public identity handles. Email/phone fields do not exist in the protocol.

links.description: GitHub usernames of confirmed friends (Link ceremony). MAY be empty; central links.json is authoritative.

bio.description: Short free-text introduction. Optional; structured fields are preferred over prose.

language.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 code, optionally with ISO 3166-1 region, e.g. en, zh, en-US.
